Since the prize is worth $25 to me, I want to bid high enough to win if others bid lower, but not so high that I risk losing money. I'll bid slightly above my value to increase my chances of winning, accounting for potential strategic bidding by others. A bid around $27-$28 seems strategic.

This approach balances potential gain against potential loss.
